headline: Prince of Persia: the 60-minute challenge
title: Prince of Persia 1989 | The 60 Minute Challenge | Classic Games
video_script: Prince of Persia came out in nineteen eighty nine, made by Jordan Mechner. You had just sixty minutes to rescue the princess. For the Prince's smooth animation, Jordan traced frames from videos of his younger brother running and jumping. Lots of players in India played it on old DOS computers. Did you? Comment below!
description: Prince of Persia (1989, Jordan Mechner) - 60 minutes to save the princess, with animation traced from real video.
